infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Caime uses the camera for video calls, and when you take a photo to send.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Caime opens your photos when you choose one to send.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Caime uses the microphone for calls, and when you record a voice message.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Caime uses your location only when you choose to share it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Caime uses your location only when you choose to share it in a conversation, once, never in the background.

plugins.contactsPermission: Caime reads your contacts on this phone to show who is already on Caime and to help you invite the rest. Only email addresses are sent, to find people, and nothing is kept.

plugins.cameraPermission: Caime uses the camera for video calls, and when you take a photo to send.
plugins.microphonePermission: Caime uses the microphone for calls, and when you record a voice message.
